title: Hop Hop 3D
description: Run {name}, the pocong who can only hop, down a three-lane graveyard path. Switch lanes, hop over tombstones and crosses, and stay low under the hanging branches. How far can you get?

how.en: Swipe left or right (or use the arrow keys / A and D) to change lane. Tap, swipe up, or press Space or W to hop over tombstones and crosses. Do not hop under a branch: change lane or stay on the ground.
how.id: Geser kiri atau kanan (atau tombol panah / A dan D) untuk pindah jalur. Tap, geser ke atas, atau tekan Spasi atau W untuk melompati nisan dan salib. Jangan lompat di bawah dahan: pindah jalur atau tetap di tanah.

en: That was short. The graveyard barely noticed you.
You hit the first thing you saw. Again.
id: Pendek banget. Kuburannya aja nggak sempat sadar kamu lewat.
Kamu nabrak yang pertama kelihatan. Ulang.

en: Not terrible. Not good either. I only have legs when I hop, so you're ahead of me.
You almost looked like you knew where you were going.
id: Lumayan. Belum bagus juga. Aku cuma bisa lompat, jadi kamu masih lebih jago.
Hampir kelihatan kamu tahu mau ke mana.

en: Fine. That was good. Don't let it go to your head.
You dodged the dead. Impressive. Rest your thumbs.
id: Kamu menghindari yang mati-mati itu. Hebat. Istirahatin jempolmu.

en: A new record. I'm almost happy. Do not tell anyone.
Your best yet. Go drink some water, you earned it.
id: Rekor baru. Aku hampir senang. Jangan bilang siapa-siapa.
Rekormu sejauh ini. Sana minum air, kamu pantas.

id.description: Larikan {name}, si pocong yang cuma bisa melompat, di jalan kuburan tiga jalur. Pindah jalur, lompati nisan dan salib, dan merunduk di bawah dahan yang menggantung. Sejauh apa kamu bisa lari?
